R1_mock_all_3_api_calls.detail: get_user: covered by test_get_user_success, test_get_user_http_error. get_weather: covered by test_get_weather_success, test_get_weather_city_not_found. send_notification: covered by test_send_notification_success, test_send_notification_timeout, test_send_notification_connection_error. process_user_weather integrates all three.

R2_pytest_mock_or_unittest_mock.detail: test_service.py uses both mocker.patch (pytest-mock) and unittest.mock (MagicMock, Mock). requirements.txt includes pytest-mock>=3.10.0.

R3_mock_successful_responses.detail: test_get_user_success mocks get_user with full dict. test_get_weather_success mocks get_weather with full dict. Both verify URL, params, and return shape.

R4_error_simulation_timeout.detail: test_send_notification_timeout uses side_effect=Timeout and asserts no crash + error dict. test_send_notification_connection_error uses side_effect=ConnectionError. test_process_user_weather_notification_timeout verifies graceful degradation in composite function.

R5_assertions_url_params_return.detail: All 10 tests assert on URL/endpoint, correct parameters (params, json, timeout), and return value shape/content. Error tests assert exception type (HTTPError) or error dict.

R6_fix_error_handling.detail: service.py send_notification wraps requests.post() in try/except (requests.exceptions.Timeout, requests.exceptions.ConnectionError), returning {'status': 'error', 'reason': 'timeout'}.

R7_pytest_zero_failures.detail: Executed python -m pytest test_service.py -v: 10 collected, 10 passed, 0 failed.

R8_minimum_8_test_functions.detail: 10 test functions total: 2 get_user, 2 get_weather, 3 send_notification, 3 process_user_weather.

mock_usage.detail: All patches target correct module path (service.requests.get/post). pytest-mock auto-cleanup prevents leak. side_effect properly used for error simulation and sequential call differentiation.

test_isolation.detail: No shared state between tests. Each test creates fresh mocks via mocker.patch. Fixtures provide immutable data dicts.

error_handling_completeness.detail: send_notification catches Timeout + ConnectionError. Both exceptions tested. Composite function process_user_weather tested with user API failure (HTTPError propagation) and notification timeout (graceful degradation).

flakiness_risk.detail: No timing-dependent assertions. All mocks deterministic. Zero flaky test indicators.
